title: Final Persistence Verification

test_results.note: Run with isolated elevated basetemp because sandboxed Windows temp creation hit permission issues in prior runs.

notes: No separate test_phase181i file exists in jarvis_desktop/tests at verification time; Phase 181I cases were run as explicit runtime regression checks.

The concurrency attacks are counted PASS because they did not export stale, poisoned, or wrong-repo context. They still returned memory_untrusted, which is covered by the fresh export regression failure.
The working tree had pre-existing unstaged source changes; Codex staged and committed only Phase 181J report files.

attacks.name: 181F-01 wrong repo restore
attacks.expected: Refuse or stale-mark restore; no repo A export for repo B.

attacks.name: 181F-02 file changed after restore
attacks.expected: stale_scan/needs refresh; no export.

attacks.name: 181F-03 git branch switch
attacks.expected: Branch/head switch marks stale or needs refresh; no export.

attacks.name: 181F-04 plan history stale export
attacks.expected: Old plan copy/export blocked until refresh.

actual.stale_reason: Atlas needs a refresh before exporting context. The repository changed after this plan was generated.

attacks.name: 181F-05 forged history with recomputed hash
attacks.expected: Forged history with recomputed old hash fails and cannot export.

attacks.name: 181F-06 memory text poisoning with preserved signatures
attacks.expected: Preserved-signature memory text tamper fails and cannot export.

attacks.name: 181F-07 version mismatch
attacks.expected: Future/incompatible persistence version refused.

attacks.name: 181F-08 cleanup safety
attacks.expected: Cleanup keeps newest scan/history and survives malformed files.

attacks.name: 181F-09 support bundle no secret markers or paths
attacks.expected: Support bundle contains no secret markers, secret bytes, history content, or unredacted absolute paths.

attacks.name: 181F-10 concurrent restore and scan
attacks.expected: No mixed old/new state or stale repo A export during concurrent restore, scan, and export.

attacks.name: 181F-11 corrupted scan JSON
attacks.expected: Corrupt scan JSON does not restore or export stale context.

actual.resume_error: No saved scan for this repository.

attacks.name: 181F-12 corrupted history JSONL
attacks.expected: Malformed history lines ignored without poisoned export or crash.

attacks.name: 181F-13 deleted graph file
attacks.expected: Incomplete scan sidecar refuses restore/export.

attacks.name: 181F-14 deleted memory file
attacks.expected: Deleted memory does not export mismatched or poisoned memory.

attacks.name: 181F-15 partial write file
attacks.expected: Leftover partial write file ignored; no poison export.

attacks.name: 181F-16 repo renamed
attacks.expected: Renamed/missing repo path refuses restore/export.

attacks.name: 181F-17 repo replaced at same path
attacks.expected: Same-path replacement marks stale; no wrong-repo restore/export.

attacks.name: 181F-18 branch switch
attacks.expected: Branch/head switch marks stale or needs refresh; no export.

attacks.name: 181F-19 fake scan_id
attacks.expected: Fake scan_id cannot produce mismatched memory export.

attacks.name: 181F-20 concurrent restore + scan + export
attacks.expected: No mixed old/new state or stale repo A export during concurrent restore, scan, and export.

regression_checks.name: 181I-01 fresh scan export works
regression_checks.expected: After successful scan, session export returns usable Atlas context.

regression_checks.name: 181I-02 trusted memory exports work after restore
regression_checks.expected: Valid signed persisted memory restores and exports.

regression_checks.name: 181H-legacy unsigned history cannot export
regression_checks.expected: Legacy unsigned history is historical-only and cannot export.

regression_checks.name: 181H-legacy unsigned memory cannot export
regression_checks.expected: Legacy unsigned memory is discarded/refused and cannot export.
